about_the_game:
Undeads is a PvP-PvE top-down shooter where survival is earned through skill, tactics, and a bit of luck.
Explore devastated cities, scavenge for loot, fight zombies and players alike, and build your reputation
in a brutal post-apocalyptic world where trust is a rare commodity.

Fast-paced firefights and explosive action await.
Switch between guns, experiment with loadouts, and make every shot count.

Open chests, collect rare items, and upgrade your gear.
Sell what you don’t need after each raid and gear up for the next one.

Enter brutal PvP battles and fight for dominance.
Use tactics, precision, and timing to outsmart every opponent.

Discover, collect, and upgrade hundreds of weapons — from classic rifles to experimental gear.
Find your perfect loadout and show the world what true firepower looks like.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Random player placement – each new match starts with players spawning in random locations, making every run unpredictable.

  • Play as humans or zombies – both sides have unique abilities and combat styles. Experiment to find your ultimate strategy.

  • Ranking and rewards – perform well in matches to climb the leaderboard and earn in-game currency.

  • Resource management – search for water, food, medicine, weapons, ammo, and valuable loot. Everything you find stays with you — if you survive.

  • Safe storage system – all collected items go into your personal vault. Expand your storage to keep more gear for future raids.

  • In-game store – trade with merchants, sell unwanted loot, and buy new weapons, ammo, and characters. Don’t miss limited-time offers!

  • Equipment durability – every weapon and armor piece wears down over time. Keep your gear in shape or risk losing it mid-fight.

  • Permanent death warning – if your character dies, everything carried is lost. Choose wisely what to take and what to leave behind.

UNDEADS WORLD

The greed of corrupt politicians, the zombie virus pandemic, reckless experiments to create super-soldiers, and sheer human panic have forged a grim world where anyone can be an ally — or an enemy.

On the battlefields, you’ll encounter townspeople and farmers, builders and engineers, bandits and hunters, survivalists and scavengers, nomads and soldiers. They face reanimated corpses, plague carriers, blood-soaked butchers, ghouls, mutant zombies, and even cybernetic undead warriors. All of them fight for a place to exist among the ruins of civilization.

Choose your characters and master their unique abilities. Form alliances or betray your partners when it serves your survival. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and rise through the ranks to carve your name into the legend of the Undeads world!

short_description: Embark on a risky but exciting journey through the world of Undeads. Search for weapons, armor, supplies and medicine. Survive or hunt survivors. Enjoy unique matches, sell your loot, and fight bloody and challenging battles against the background of the zombie apocalypse!
